verdict.rationale: Patent and trade mark databases and register services can plausibly offer scheduled or recurring monitoring searches, so this axis applies to DPMA. The evidence pack covers only search databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing routes (DPMAdirektWeb/Pro, paper, ePCT). Nothing documents scheduling recurring jobs, watch alerts or automated workflows, and the filing deadlines it mentions are statutory time limits, not a scheduling feature.
